rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] how raiders had sacked [INITIATOR_possessive] home town.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] described to [RECIPIENT_nameDef] the smoke over [INITIATOR_possessive] town.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that people back home were going hungry.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] whether the colony had food to spare for [INITIATOR_possessive] town.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] about the war [INITIATOR_possessive] people were fighting.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] warned [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that the roads were full of war bands.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] about the fair back home and invited [RECIPIENT_objective] to come.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] described the fair's stalls and music to [RECIPIENT_nameDef].
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] boasted to [RECIPIENT_nameDef] about how well [INITIATOR_possessive] town was doing.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] about the new houses going up back home.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] thanked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] for letting one of [INITIATOR_possessive] people go home.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that [INITIATOR_possessive] town still talked about the prisoner the colony had freed.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] reminded [RECIPIENT_nameDef] coldly of the prisoner from [INITIATOR_possessive] town who had died here.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] refused to look at [RECIPIENT_nameDef], muttering about the dead prisoner.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] greeted each other like old friends.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] was glad to see [RECIPIENT_nameDef] again and asked how [RECIPIENT_pronoun] had been.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] lowered [INITIATOR_possessive] voice and warned [RECIPIENT_nameDef] of a blood feud sworn against the colony.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] what people were saying about an oath of vengeance.
